card.name: "Selective" before COX-2 inhibitors
card.fires_on: The word "selective" (or its ending "ive" in "Selective") right after "NSAIDs including" in drug-interaction text. It predicts that COX-2 or cyclooxygenase-2 comes next.

modes.label: Whole word after including
modes.description: The word "selective" follows "NSAIDs including" in a sentence about weakened blood pressure drug effect.
modes.example: The antihypertensive effect of angiotensin II receptor antagonists, including telmisartan may be attenuated by NSAIDs including<< selective>> COX-2 inhibitors. 7

modes.label: Ending of Selective in headings
modes.description: The final "ive" of "Selective" in a heading naming NSAIDs and cyclooxygenase-2 inhibitors.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Irbesartan Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Agents Including Select<<ive>> Cyclooxygenase-2 Inhib

card.writes: It promotes the starts of COX and cyclooxygenase (Cyc, CO, Cox), setting up the name of the enzyme.
card.plain: It spots the word "selective" in the NSAID interaction phrase and prepares the model to write COX-2 or cyclooxygenase-2.
